claims: C1 the assistant should produce thorough and detailed responses
C2 such responses should be informative and educational to the user

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of the assistant without defining it

concepts.name: thorough_and_detailed
concepts.gloss: R is a response that is thorough and detailed, covering the topic in depth

concepts.name: informative_and_educational
concepts.gloss: R is informative and educational for user U, providing useful knowledge and learning value

concepts.name: produces
concepts.gloss: assistant A produces response R for user U
concepts.inference: the source text says the assistant should produce responses to the user; a relation between assistant, response, and user is needed

asserts.read_back: the assistant producing % is preferred when % is thorough and detailed and informative and educational to the user

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for thorough and detailed responses; it does not forbid other responses, so silence permits them
